svg.font-family: system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: M — Felt and stitch · Thrills & Chills round-4 art concept
svg.text: A plush toy park sewn from felt: padded panels with dashed
stitch seams, buttons for eyes and details, yarn rails on
knitted posts, a soft fuzzy fibre over everything. Cosy.

g.text: Every panel = flat felt + a puff (inner shadow).
Seams: dashed thread, 4 px in from each edge.
Buttons for eyes, cherries, car badges.
One fibre + fuzz filter over the whole scene.
